source: Chief Architect X18 Tutorial Guide, Landscaping Tutorials, pages 382-402

steps.step: A separate plan file for the plot plan (File > New Plan, Save As Chic Cottage-Plot Plan)
steps.gap: Done in the house plan here; a separate file works the same and is copied in later. North for the site and for the house is one setting. Row: SITE-28

steps.step: CAD defaults: line lengths in decimal feet (2 places), angles as quadrant bearings
steps.gap: Lengths show in the plan's display unit; angles in degrees. No per-view decimal-feet or bearing display for CAD lines. Row: SITE-29

steps.step: Input Point at (0,0); Input Line with three sides from the lot description (one entered reversed: S 49 59 11 W)
The fourth side: Change Line/Arc, an arc of 450' radius bowing out of the lot
Show Length and Show Angle on the lot lines
Setback lines: Concentric edit 10', copy inward; dashed line style on its own layer 'CAD, Setback Lines'

steps.gap: No Concentric edit behaviour; Offset (CAD) or the plot lines' setback makes the inner line. Row: CAD-32

steps.step: Copy the lot and setback into the house plan; Convert Polyline > Terrain Perimeter (replacing the Decks and Porches one)
Rotate the lot, setback and North Pointer 1 30 25 so the back lot line is parallel to the house
(Rotate the north pointer with the lot; bearings measured from it)
steps.gap: The north pointer isn't an object you rotate with the lot; set North's angle. Lot labels keep the bearings typed. Row: SITE-28

steps.step: Position the lot: the back right corner of the main roof 50' from the back setback and 30' from the right one
(Moving a selection by typing on a dimension; point markers; Point to Point Move)
Save and close the plot plan file; Make a Copy of CURRENT as Chic Cottage-Plot Plan
